name: Ubadiyu
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: A winter dish of potatoes, green beans, purple yam and sweet potatoes cooked with herbs in an earthen pot set upside down in a fire. It is similar to Gujarati undhiyu, and the herbs kalar (Indian nettle) and kamboi give it an earthy smell.
how_to_eat: Eat it hot on a winter night with buttermilk spiced with turmeric.
how_to_order: Ask for 'ubadiyu' at roadside stalls around Silvassa in winter.

name: Turmeric Buttermilk
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Warm buttermilk spiced with a pinch of turmeric, drunk with or after meals. In Silvassa it is the traditional partner of ubadiyu.
how_to_eat: Drink it alongside ubadiyu or after a meal.
how_to_order: Ask for 'chaas' with your meal at a local eatery.

name: Nagli Rotla
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Flatbread made from ragi, called nagli locally; rice and jowar flours are also staples of Silvassa's cooking. Millet rotla and kodri (barnyard millet) dishes are signature foods of the territory.
how_to_eat: Eat it with a vegetable dish or curry.
how_to_order: Ask for 'nagli roti' or 'rotla' at a village-style eatery around Silvassa.

name: Ponk
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Tender green sorghum grains, roasted and beaten from the husk, eaten as a winter snack, often with sev. Incredible India lists paunk among Silvassa's local specialities.
how_to_eat: Eat it fresh in winter, mixed with sev.
how_to_order: Ask for 'ponk' at stalls in winter.

name: River Fish Curry
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Freshwater fish such as rohu, katla and mrigal from local rivers are cooked regularly in Silvassa homes. They make up the inland side of the territory's fish cooking.
how_to_order: Ask for the day's river fish at a local restaurant in Silvassa.

name: Crab Curry
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Freshly caught crab, an all-time local favourite in Silvassa, and seasonal spicy crab gravies on the Daman and Diu coast.
how_to_eat: Crack the shells by hand and eat with rice.
how_to_order: Ask what crab is in season at a seafood restaurant.

name: Coconut Fish Curry
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: A coastal fish curry, tangy and spiced, often with coconut, made with the local catch. Fish, coconut and rice are the base of the coastal cooking of Daman and Diu.
how_to_order: Ask for the 'fish curry' with the day's catch, such as pomfret or surmai, at a beach-side restaurant.

name: Prawn Masala
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Prawns cooked in a bold, spiced masala, also served dry-fried as a prawn fry. It is a signature dish of the territory's coastal kitchens.
how_to_eat: Eat it with rice or bread.
how_to_order: Ask for 'prawn masala' or 'prawn fry' at a seafood restaurant.

name: Bombil Fry
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Bombay duck fish marinated in spices and deep-fried until crisp, a signature fish dish of Daman.
how_to_eat: Eat it hot as a starter.
how_to_order: Ask for 'bombil fry' at beach-side eateries in Daman.

name: Pomfret Recheado
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Pomfret or other fish stuffed with a spicy, sour recheado masala and fried, a Portuguese-influenced dish found in Daman and Diu restaurants.
how_to_order: Ask for 'recheado' fish at a seafood restaurant.

name: Diu Chouriço
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Diu's chouriço sausage of pork, chillies and spices, a legacy of Portuguese rule. It is eaten on its own or cooked into curries.
how_to_eat: Eat it fried on its own or in a curry with bread.
how_to_order: Ask for 'chouriço' at restaurants in Diu.

name: Khaman Dhokla
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Steamed gram-flour cakes listed among Silvassa's local specialities, reflecting the territory's strong Gujarati influence. They are also a common snack in Daman and Diu.
how_to_eat: Eat it with green chutney and tea.
how_to_order: Ask for 'khaman' by weight at a farsan shop.

name: Doodh Pak
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: A rice pudding of thickened milk, sugar and nuts, named among Silvassa's local specialities.
how_to_eat: Eat it warm or chilled, with puri.
how_to_order: Ask for 'doodh pak' on a Gujarati thali.
